sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vaults" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en-US', "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(vault_id)REFERENCES vaults(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vault_cloud_bindings" ("vault_id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "auth_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "linked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(vault_id)REFERENCES vaults(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "currencies" ("code" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "numeric_code" TEXT, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "institution" TEXT, "account_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "nature" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT, "color" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "include_in_net_worth" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "opened_on" TEXT, "closed_on" TEXT, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(vault_id)REFERENCES vaults(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_pockets" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, FOREIGN KEY(account_id)REFERENCES accounts(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(currency_code)REFERENCES currencies(code), UNIQUE(account_id, currency_code));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT, "category_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "system_key" TEXT, "custom_name" TEXT, "custom_name_en_us" TEXT, "custom_name_pt_br" TEXT, "icon" TEXT, "color" TEXT, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(vault_id)REFERENCES vaults(id), FOREIGN KEY(parent_id)REFERENCES categories(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en_us" TEXT, "name_pt_br" TEXT, "color" TEXT, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(vault_id)REFERENCES vaults(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "counterparties" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "counterparty_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'merchant', "notes" TEXT, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(vault_id)REFERENCES vaults(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "counterparty_aliases" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "counterparty_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(counterparty_id)REFERENCES counterparties(id)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cleared', "counterparty_id" TEXT, "title" TEXT, "description" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "payment_method" TEXT, "occurred_at" INTEGER, "financial_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT, "location_name" TEXT, "latitude" REAL, "longitude" REAL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "recurring_rule_id" TEXT, "recurrence_date" TEXT, "reversal_of_id" TEXT, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(vault_id)REFERENCES vaults(id), FOREIGN KEY(counterparty_id)REFERENCES counterparties(id), FOREIGN KEY(reversal_of_id)REFERENCES transactions(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_movements" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_pocket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "statement_id" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id)REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(account_pocket_id)REFERENCES account_pockets(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_splits" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "memo" TEXT, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id)REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(category_id)REFERENCES categories(id), FOREIGN KEY(currency_code)REFERENCES currencies(code));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_tags" ("transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(transaction_id, tag_id), FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id)REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(tag_id)REFERENCES tags(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fx_conversions" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_movement_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_movement_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exchange_rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_date" TEXT, "provider" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id)REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_rules" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "rrule" TEXT NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "ends_on" TEXT, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "next_occurrence" TEXT, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(vault_id)REFERENCES vaults(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_templates" ("recurring_rule_id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "transaction_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "counterparty_id" TEXT, "title" TEXT, "description" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "payment_method" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(recurring_rule_id)REFERENCES recurring_rules(id)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_template_movements" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "recurring_rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_pocket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(recurring_rule_id)REFERENCES recurring_rules(id)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_template_splits" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "recurring_rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(recurring_rule_id)REFERENCES recurring_rules(id)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_card_profiles" ("account_id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "default_closing_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "default_due_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(account_id)REFERENCES accounts(id)ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_card_limits" ("account_pocket_id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(account_pocket_id)REFERENCES account_pockets(id)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_card_statements" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_pocket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_start" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_end" TEXT NOT NULL, "closing_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(account_pocket_id)REFERENCES account_pockets(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installment_plans" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_pocket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "counterparty_id" TEXT, "category_id" TEXT, "description" TEXT, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "installment_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_installment_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "interest_rate" TEXT, "recognition_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'installment_date', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installments" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "installment_plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "installment_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT, "statement_id" TEXT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled', FOREIGN KEY(installment_plan_id)REFERENCES installment_plans(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE(installment_plan_id, installment_number));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "starts_on" TEXT, "ends_on" TEXT, "warning_threshold_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8000, "rollover_policy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_categories" ("budget_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "include_descendants" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(budget_id, category_id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_accounts" ("budget_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(budget_id, account_id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_tags" ("budget_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(budget_id, tag_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "starts_on" TEXT, "target_date" TEXT, "planned_monthly_minor" INTEGER, "tracking_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_accounts" ("goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_pocket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(goal_id, account_pocket_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_contributions" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "contribution_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(goal_id)REFERENCES goals(id)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assets" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "acquired_on" TEXT, "acquisition_cost_minor" INTEGER, "valuation_method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "annual_rate" TEXT, "useful_life_months" INTEGER, "salvage_value_minor" INTEGER, "include_in_net_worth" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "notes" TEXT, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_valuations" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "valuation_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(asset_id)REFERENCES assets(id)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investment_instruments" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_class" TEXT NOT NULL, "exchange" TEXT, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "isin" TEXT, "provider_symbol" TEXT, "provider_name" TEXT, "custom_instrument" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investment_events" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" TEXT, "unit_price" TEXT, "price_currency_code" TEXT, "gross_minor" INTEGER, "fees_minor" INTEGER, "taxes_minor" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id)REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(instrument_id)REFERENCES investment_instruments(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investment_lots" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "acquisition_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "acquired_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_quantity" TEXT NOT NULL, "cost_basis_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(acquisition_event_id)REFERENCES investment_events(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investment_lot_disposals" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "disposal_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" TEXT NOT NULL, "allocated_cost_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(disposal_event_id)REFERENCES investment_events(id), FOREIGN KEY(lot_id)REFERENCES investment_lots(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fx_rate_cache" ("base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(base_currency, quote_currency, rate_date, provider));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "manual_fx_rates" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "market_price_cache" ("instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(instrument_id, price_timestamp, provider));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "manual_market_prices" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_filename" TEXT, "mime_type" TEXT, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachment_links" ("attachment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(attachment_id, entity_type, entity_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_entity_state" ("entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_synced_revision" INTEGER, "server_version" INTEGER, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(entity_type, record_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("operation_id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_revision" INTEGER, "base_snapshot" TEXT, "new_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_retry_at" INTEGER, "last_error_code" TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("vault_id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "last_server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_pull_at" INTEGER, "last_push_at" INTEGER, "last_success_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remote_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "base_snapshot" TEXT, "local_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "detected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER, "resolution" TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_preferences" ("key" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vault_preferences" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, UNIQUE(vault_id, "key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_vault_date ON transactions (vault_id, financial_date DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_movements_pocket ON account_movements (account_pocket_id, transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_categories_parent ON categories (vault_id, parent_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_counterparties_name ON counterparties (vault_id, name)
CREATE INDEX idx_statements_account_due ON credit_card_statements (account_pocket_id, due_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_goals_status ON goals (vault_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_investment_events_instrument ON investment_events (instrument_id, transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_sync_outbox_retry ON sync_outbox (next_retry_at, created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_vault_history ON transactions (vault_id, financial_date DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_vault_type_status_date ON transactions (vault_id, transaction_type, status, financial_date DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_movements_amount ON account_movements (amount_minor, transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_splits_category ON transaction_splits (category_id, transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_transaction_tags_tag ON transaction_tags (tag_id, transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pockets_currency ON account_pockets (currency_code, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_transactions_recurrence ON transactions (recurring_rule_id, recurrence_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_recurring_rules_vault_next ON recurring_rules (vault_id, enabled, next_occurrence) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
